colorSplit.$description: Used as the color of separator, this color is the same as colorBorderSecondary but with transparency.

fontSizeIcon.$description: Control the font size of operation icon in Select, Cascader, etc. Normally same as fontSizeSM.

controlInteractiveSize.$description: Control the interactive size of control component.

paddingXL.$description: Control the extra large padding of the element.

paddingLG.$description: Control the large padding of the element.

paddingMD.$description: Control the medium padding of the element.

padding.$description: Control the padding of the element.

paddingSM.$description: Control the small padding of the element.

paddingXS.$description: Control the extra small padding of the element.

paddingXXS.$description: Control the extra extra small padding of the element.

marginXXL.$description: Control the margin of an element, with the largest size.

marginXL.$description: Control the margin of an element, with an extra-large size.

marginLG.$description: Control the margin of an element, with a large size.

marginMD.$description: Control the margin of an element, with a medium-large size.

margin.$description: Control the margin of an element, with a medium size.

marginSM.$description: Control the margin of an element, with a medium-small size.

marginXS.$description: Control the margin of an element, with a small size.

marginXXS.$description: Control the margin of an element, with the smallest size.

controlPaddingHorizontal.$description: Control the horizontal padding of an element.

controlPaddingHorizontalSM.$description: Control the horizontal padding of an element with a small-medium size.

paddingContentHorizontalLG.$description: Control the horizontal padding of content element, suitable for large screen devices.

paddingContentVerticalLG.$description: Control the vertical padding of content element, suitable for large screen devices.

paddingContentHorizontal.$description: Control the horizontal padding of content element.

paddingContentVertical.$description: Control the vertical padding of content element.

paddingContentHorizontalSM.$description: Control the horizontal padding of content element, suitable for small screen devices.

paddingContentVerticalSM.$description: Control the vertical padding of content element, suitable for small screen devices.

colorLinkHover.$description: Control the color of hyperlink when hovering.

colorLinkActive.$description: Control the color of hyperlink when clicked.

colorFillContent.$description: Control the background color of content area.

colorFillContentHover.$description: Control the style of background color of content area when mouse hovers over it.

colorFillAlter.$description: Control the alternative background color of element.

colorBgContainerDisabled.$description: Control the background color of container in disabled state.

colorBorderBg.$description: Control the color of background border of element.

colorTextPlaceholder.$description: Control the color of placeholder text.

colorTextDisabled.$description: Control the color of text in disabled state.

colorTextHeading.$description: Control the font color of heading.

colorTextLabel.$description: Control the font color of text label.

colorTextDescription.$description: Control the font color of text description.

colorTextLightSolid.$description: Control the highlight color of text with background color, such as the text in Primary Button components.

colorHighlight.$description: Control the color of page element when highlighted.

colorBgTextHover.$description: Control the background color of text in hover state.

colorBgTextActive.$description: Control the background color of text in active state.

colorIcon.$description: Weak action. Such as `allowClear` or Alert close button

colorIconHover.$description: Weak action hover color. Such as `allowClear` or Alert close button

colorErrorOutline.$description: Control the outline color of input component in error state.

colorWarningOutline.$description: Control the outline color of input component in warning state.

controlItemBgHover.$description: Control the background color of control component item when hovering.

controlItemBgActive.$description: Control the background color of control component item when active.

controlItemBgActiveHover.$description: Control the background color of control component item when hovering and active.

controlItemBgActiveDisabled.$description: Control the background color of control component item when active and disabled.

controlOutline.$description: Control the outline color of input component.

controlOutlineWidth.$description: Control the outline width of input component.

opacityLoading.$description: Control the opacity of the loading state.

screenXS.$description: Control the screen width of extra small screens.

screenSM.$description: Control the screen width of small screens.

screenMD.$description: Control the screen width of medium screens.

screenLG.$description: Control the screen width of large screens.

screenXL.$description: Control the screen width of extra large screens.

screenXXL.$description: Control the screen width of extra extra large screens.

screenXSMin.$description: Control the minimum width of extra small screens.

screenXSMax.$description: Control the maximum width of extra small screens.

screenSMMin.$description: Control the minimum width of small screens.

screenSMMax.$description: Control the maximum width of small screens.

screenMDMin.$description: Control the minimum width of medium screens.

screenMDMax.$description: Control the maximum width of medium screens.

screenLGMin.$description: Control the minimum width of large screens.

screenLGMax.$description: Control the maximum width of large screens.

screenXLMin.$description: Control the minimum width of extra large screens.

screenXLMax.$description: Control the maximum width of extra large screens.

screenXXLMin.$description: Control the minimum width of extra extra large screens.

linkDecoration.$description: Control the text decoration style of a link.

linkFocusDecoration.$description: Control the text decoration style of a link on focus.

linkHoverDecoration.$description: Control the text decoration style of a link on mouse hover.
